content:
alex: FYI — incident yesterday caused sustained tail latency and we burned ~72% of the web SLO error budget. Proposing a short SLO reset window and a dashboard update. Thoughts?

maria: ugh. thanks. do you have the burn graph? link?

alex: https://grafana.redwood/net/d/abcd/slo-burn — check panels p50/p95 and 'error_budget_burn'.

joel-sre: I saw the spike at 03:12UTC. root cause is KV cache miss storm after the model-serving deploy; repro steps + logs in the postmortem doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC-2026-03-kv-cache-miss

pat: +1 to temporary SLO window. we need a clear owner for SLO ops and for the recurring-pattern analysis. @maria can you own the SLO/reset and dashboard changes?

maria: I can take SLO reset and dashboard. Will add a per-model and per-region breakdown and a solid 80% burn alert. ETA: today EOD.

sammie: Also recommend adding an alert on 'prefill_kv_cache_miss_rate' to catch the pattern earlier.

alex: Proposed short-term change: p95 latency SLO from `<= 250ms` to `<= 400ms` for a 2h maintenance window on 2026-03-25T23:00Z. Rationale: gives us time to roll a safe config and monitor error budget recovery. If burn >85% after window we escalate to full rollback.

maria: I'll add the SLO window via the control plane and wire the Slack notification: `devops-bot: scheduled slo-window id=slo-20260325-1 owner=maria window=2h change=p95:250->400`.

devops-bot: scheduled SLO window created: id=slo-20260325-1 by maria

joel-sre: recurring pattern owner? we had a similar incident 2025-11-12 and 2026-01-09. need root-cause depth work and deploy-gating.

pat: I'll lead the recurring-incident analysis, correlating deploys, kv config, and traffic spikes. Creating ticket RED-2034 and assigning to infra+runtime. ETA: Friday EOD.

maria: created tasks in RED board: [RED-2034] recurring-kv-pattern (assignee: pat), [RED-2035] dashboard+alerts (assignee: maria), [RED-2036] SLO-window docs (assignee: maria).

alex: let's reconvene Mon 10am PT to review error-budget after the window and decide on permanent SLO or infra fixes. calendar invite sent.

sammie: invite accepted. :eyes:

alex: Thanks everyone — closing thread unless blockers. Keep updates on RED-2034/2035.
